tasks.name: Palindrome function
tasks.prompt: Write a Python function called is_palindrome(s) that returns True if the string s is a palindrome (reads the same forwards and backwards), and False otherwise. Ignore case and non-alphanumeric characters. Return only the function definition.

tasks.name: Fibonacci sequence generator
tasks.prompt: Write a Python function fibonacci(n) that returns the first n numbers in the Fibonacci sequence (starting with 0, 1). Return the result as a list. Return only the function definition.
